searchText: Can one of you attending the epbs breakout rooms please make sure to be at ACDT and give us a testing update so we know how things are going? i've added it to the agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1692 Yes I started attending ACDT. Went there on Monday Is anyone passing the latest ssz vector spec test for `BeaconBlockBody` for eip7732? Another question, since we replaced `ExecutionPayloadHeader` from a blind-payload like object, to a completely different bid like object. All the light client objects are messed up in Gloas. One easy fix is to avoid naming it `ExecutionPayloadHeader`, or we can fix the spec. cc <@881905303011086387> <@592004585506340885> What would be an alternative name? `ExecutionPayloadBid`? Unless <@881905303011086387> thinks fixing it would be easy, I would be in favor of renaming. Good with me, I'm not opinionated on naming at all. Favor of renaming as well If we do rename, I wonder for `BeaconState`, we should use a new field instead replace current field https://github.com/potuz/consensus-specs/pull/18 I did a pass on light client a while back, see > **Notice**: EIP-7732 changes semantics of `ExecutionPayloadHeader` to refer to a bid instead of data that has been included on chain. This type restores the original semantics of `ExecutionPayloadHeader` as in [Electra](../../../electra/beacon-chain.md#executionpayloadheader), while using a new name to avoid name conflicts. This is a current bug that was discussed a couple of calls ago in the breakout call. We could also deal with this simply moving the processing of requests to after the pending payment, but anyway this helper should be modifed IMO so I opted for this simple change. cc <@935504619554107392> h/t for pinging about this. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4513 (deleted my message, I think it's wrong) I'm in favor of using new name for ExecutionPayloadHeader, too, as it just isn't the same thing anymore. but can be addressed later as well also kudos to <@386270194269421580>. We discovered it together there was also the other issue that if a block finalizes where withdrawals were debited, but not yet credited on the EL, and then the network is re-synced using that checkpoint, the network stalls because noone has the data anymore about the pending withdrawals (may need to stash them away in the beaconstate somewhere). not sure if that is important or if it has already been addressed <@363800010518822915> not sure how to go here cause you are adding tests for the payload envelope processing. In principle we could merge my PR as-is and then add a test to your PR to test this bug, or I could add a test to my PR but I think then I would rather merge your PR first and then have it fail on my PR ok sure, ill focus on your feedback now, will ping you to review in an hour or two FWIW, this is something that has been requested numerous times, people want to call it bid and I am myself calling it bid colloquially. I have deferred any discussions about naming for long but probably now it's a good time based on my comment in the old PR, "EIP-7732 changes semantics of ExecutionPayloadHeader to refer to a bid", maybe `ExecutionPayloadBid` is good potential conflict with "bid" is that sometimes it's used as "block ID" but that's more of an internal thing, ExecutionPayloadBid seems better to me than ExecutionPayloadHeader `ExecutionPayloadBid` is good with me, but it shouldn't replace the current `latest_execution_payload_header` field anymore in `BeaconState` rather it would have its own field . Any concern with this? Can we have two types? `ExecutionPayloadHeader` and `ExecutionPayloadBid`? Would these be the exact same or would the bid need extra fields (eg value). the bid does not contain all the fields from the header, it's a separate thing the header is a summary of the full ExecutionPayload like, with same hash_tree_root I personally dont see any reason to cache `ExecutionPayloadHeader` in state, and we would have to add it to `process_execution_payload` to caching it but maybe im missing something here The execution payload header was always useless in the state. The idea was that lightclients could prove against the block or something but that header has always been useless for the most. The hash is essentially all that matters. I mean if there is pressure to keep the header around we can add these fields to the bid, but It makes it ugly and bulky for no useful reason, the beacon chain has no use for any of these fields and we should have kept a better strict separation of consensus from execution as ePBS is a good step in that direction, I would like to get rid of any execution mentions on the CL, keep the blockhash and let clients prove against that. all your feedback should be addressed here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4458/commits/d7c36fb2ad611383506ce86c16ab2d91337df1a6 please take a look. I think this unit test `test_process_execution_payload_self_build_zero_value` should fail in your PR The lint check is failing thanks, pushed
